+import plac
+
+from bamboo.blueprints.command import create_admin, create_tables, drop_tables
+
+
+def _app_context():
+    from app import app
+
+    return app.app_context()
+
+
+def main(
+    command: str,
+    username: str | None = None,
+    password: str | None = None,
+    name: str | None = None,
+    email: str | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    with _app_context():
+        if command == "create-tables":
+            create_tables()
+            return
+
+        if command == "drop-tables":
+            drop_tables()
+            return
+
+        if command == "create-admin":
+            create_admin(username=username, password=password, name=name, email=email)
+            return
+
+        raise SystemExit(f"Unknown command: {command}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    plac.call(main)
